title: literature-translator result schema
description: Schema for the literature-translator Skill: glossary entries, aligned paragraph pairs, and the top-level result.json that carries evidence and uncertainty for verifiable academic translation.

term.description: Exact source surface form (case-sensitive for acronyms/formulas; case-insensitive for plain words).

translation.description: The ONLY allowed translation when status=locked. May equal 'term' for formulas/proper nouns kept untranslated.

variants.description: Other source surface forms that map to the SAME translation.

context.description: A short source snippet showing the term in use, for disambiguation.

first_location.description: First source paragraph id where the term appears, e.g. P0002.

domain.description: Subject domain the entry belongs to.

status.description: locked = enforce everywhere; pending = candidate not yet used; uncertain = translation uncertain and must be flagged in output.

note.description: Rationale for the chosen translation (e.g. standard translation in the field, kept as formula).

id.description: Placeholder id, e.g. NUMBER_0003, UNIT_0005, CITATION_0002, REF_0001, FORMULA_0001.

text.description: The verbatim source surface to preserve.

start.description: Character offset in the source text.

end.description: Character offset (exclusive) in the source text.

span.description: The exact source text span that is uncertain (may be empty for whole-paragraph uncertainty).

reason.description: Why it is uncertain: OCR noise, unreadable formula image, ambiguous term, truncated text, conflicting source.

translation_if_any.description: The translation that was still produced, if any.

target_id.description: Target paragraph id; must equal source_id for 1:1 alignment.

source_location.description: Where the paragraph sits in the source (page and line span).

glossary_terms_used.description: Glossary term surfaces used in this paragraph, with their locked translations applied.

rationale.description: Why this translation was chosen: glossary mapping, kept-verbatim tokens, structural notes.

uncertain.description: Uncertain spans explicitly marked, never silently smoothed over.

type.description: One of: term_drift, term_untranslated, term_missing_translation, paragraph_inventory, token_missing, number_drift, negation_possibly_dropped, qualifier_possibly_dropped.

status.description: success = all paragraphs translated and QA passed; partial = some paragraphs/fields missing or QA warnings remain; failed = no usable output.

task.description: Short statement of the translation task performed.

extraction_method.description: native-text-layer | pdftotext | pymupdf | pypdf | pdfminer | ocr | manual.

ocr.description: True if the text layer came from OCR (all paragraphs are then low confidence).

uncertainties.description: Flat list of every uncertain span, in addition to being inline on each paragraph.

protected_tokens.description: Inventory of numbers/units/citations/refs/formulas that were protected during translation.

output_contract.description: Every field required by /input/case.json output_contract, copied verbatim, in addition to the fields above.

change_log.description: Ordered list of what was changed and why (for reproducibility and idempotent re-runs).
